title: Readiness tab panel renderer
description: renderReadinessPanel(result, { profile, freezeRecord }) returns the eleven ordered blocks of spec section 5 for the Readiness tab: tree line, two verdict pills with formatVerdictLines labels, two per-persona next-action lines, D1..D8 state chips, blockers grouped by persona (register orders the pair; the non-register group collapses with its count visible, never omitted), delta list, per-stage check detail, coverage tree-vs-delta, decisions outstanding, Freeze now control (enabled iff levels.readyToBuild.ok), freeze record. Pure: no I/O, no recompute. pickRegister helper mirrors the CLI's contract.
